note: Extractor test fixture: Veikko reports first hand that the OULU-03 barrier key moved. Written by hand.

messages.author: Aino Ahola
messages.text: Heads up, tomorrow's dispatch goes to OULU-03 again, the one with the locked barrier on the private road.

messages.author: Veikko Vikkelä
messages.text: I was there this morning. The key isn't at the Mäkelä farm anymore. the key moved, it's in the site cabinet now
